# Welcome

This is the companion website for the **Programming** (Программирование) course at Южный Федеральный Университет, 2026.

**Language:** C / C++
**Structure:** 1 semester · 18 lectures · 8 modules
**RPD:** А.С. Свиридов, 2026

---

## How to use this site

Each lecture page is the **student handout** — clean reference material covering the key concepts, worked examples, a key-terms table, and discussion questions.

Navigate using the table of contents on the left (or the menu on mobile).

---

## Course Structure

| Module | Topic | Lectures |
|--------|-------|---------|
| 1 | Basics of C/C++, I/O, Linear Algorithms | L01–L04 |
| 2 | Branching and Loops | L05 |
| 3 | Arrays, Pointers, Strings | L06–L07 |
| 4 | Subroutines | L08 |
| 5 | File Handling | L09 |
| 6 | User-Defined Data Types | L10–L11 |
| 7 | Multithreaded Programming + AI | L12–L15 |
| 8 | Libraries, Standard Structures, Algorithms | L16–L18 |
